description:
Kviria finds the place, address or street corner a user means near their current position and returns its verified coordinate with an evidence trail.

When to call: on every user turn of a place conversation, from the first time the user mentions a place, a kind of place, an address, a street, a corner or what is around them, until the place is settled. That includes yes or no answers, picks ("the second one"), corrections ("no, the other one"), follow-ups ("what's across from it") and questions about your last answer ("are you sure?"). Kviria resolves each of these from the state, so do not answer them yourself.

What to send: transcript is the user's whole last turn, word for word. state is the `state` field of the previous kviria response, copied exactly: that field only, never the whole response; send an empty string on the first call. anchor is the user's current position exactly as you were given it: send it on the first call, and after that only when the position changes; never invent or round it.

What comes back, and your move: one - the place is settled; say its name and distance exactly as returned. one_unconfirmed - ask "Is it {name} ({distanceM} m)?" and send the user's answer as the next call. many - name the candidates with their distances, ask which one, and send the user's answer as the next call. none - Kviria looked and found nothing; say so and ask for a nearby business or landmark. unclear - ask the user to say more about the place. not_a_place_request - the user's words are not about a place; reply to the user yourself.

Phrase your reply from the returned facts only; never invent a place, a distance or any other detail. Distances are meters; convert them for your user.

Coverage: the contiguous United States. Outside it the answer is none with an out_of_coverage entry and the turn is free; tell the user instead of retrying.

Errors: 400 invalid_state means the state was altered; start again with an empty state. 503 parser_unavailable: do not retry the call. Tell the user you cannot look it up right now and to ask again in a moment; never ask the user to rephrase for it.

anchor.description: The user's current position - Kviria resolves relative to this point. Required on the first call of a conversation; later calls may leave it out while the user has not moved.

confirmation.description: "on" (default): a place the user named only in part is returned as one_unconfirmed, and its coordinate is released only after the user verifies it. "off": it is returned as one immediately, for agents without a human in the loop.

rangeM.description: Search radius around the anchor in meters (clamped to 50-350).

state.description: The `state` field of the previous kviria response, copied character for character: that field only, never the whole response, and never shortened. Empty string on the first call.

transcript.description: The user's whole last turn, word for word: yes or no, corrections, hesitations and everything around the place included. Never shorten, rephrase, correct or complete it. If one turn arrived in pieces, join them in order.

name: kviria

acrossStreet.description: Set when the user named a street to be across, or when the place is on a corner and so has two acrosses: one answer per street, each naming the street it is across.

address.description: Address facts when the target is a house/unit.

baseDistanceM.description: Set when the answer is relative to a place (near, across, next to): metres from that place. distanceM stays the distance from the user.

gers.description: Stable global entity id, persistent across turns and sessions.

intersection.description: Set when the target is a street corner: every street that meets there. Such a target has category and confidence null.

location.description: Named lat/lng fields; no coordinate-array ordering ambiguity. Absent on one_unconfirmed: the coordinate comes with the user's yes.

name.description: The place name as-is; never paraphrase it.

candidates.description: The candidates to present on many. Never send them back: send state.

category.description: The category that was asked for and is absent, on a none decision.

confirmed.description: True when the user verified the target through the confirm gate.

decision.description: The decision for this turn: how many answers there are and whether the single answer is certain, or not_a_place_request when the user's words are not about a place. An exact address is "one" with the door facts riding target.address; several door clusters for one number come back as "many".

evidence.description: Why this answer: the gate trail behind the decision. Present none of this to the user; it exists for trust and auditability.

reasonCode.description: Stable enum explaining the outcome (e.g. user_confirmed, single_survivor_pending, partial_name, out_of_coverage). Read the code, never the free text.

state.description: The conversation state. Send it back unchanged as `state` on the next call.

target.description: The settled target (one), or the target waiting for the user's yes or no (one_unconfirmed, without a location).

title: Kviria
